serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
It’s in even more disorder than I remembered… 
With no priestbot or Shanice to take care of this place the situation here is getting worse and worse…
What will happen to this place? Is it just going to decay for years and  be destroyed?
Why is no one from the Church here?
This all is just too bizarre. Something is not right for sure…
I need to search this place, I doubt I will find anything, but that’s why I came here after all.
When I was here the last time, that guy was already ending cleaning…{{wi}} what was left of Shanice…
I’m still shaking…{{wi}} I don’t want to end up like her…
Let’s get this over with, I don’t feel safe being here…
Shit…
I don’t have a flashlight. Should have planned it at least a little instead of just coming on a whim.
Whatever, my phone’s flash will do.
Nothing in the back, but to be honest I’m not sure what I’m even looking for.
Footprints? Come on man, it’s not a tv show…
There’s only one place I need to look at…{{wi}} the place in which Shanice probably died…
It’s really hard on me, my heart beats faster by only coming closer to these benches…
You: What the fuck?!
